biggest_catch: This is a limited-time promotion - qualifying referrals must occur between 9/1/26 and 10/31/26 - and the friend's product must stay open a full 60 days before anyone is paid, so the reward is slow to arrive.
catches: Qualifying referrals must occur between 9/1/26 - 10/31/26; limited-time promotion.

Referee must be a new member to MAX and must open a new share account plus one qualifying product: a checking account open for 60 days with a direct deposit, a consumer loan open for 60 days, or a consumer credit card open for 60 days.
Loan and credit card referrals are subject to credit approval ('For Qualified Borrowers').
Reward is 15,000 points (worth $150) deposited into each party's rewards account 60 days after the qualifying account/loan is opened; points can be redeemed for cash in branch or online.
Friend can apply in branch or online but must use your referral code to earn referral rewards.

steps: Share your MAX referral code with a friend.

Friend applies in branch or online, opens a new MAX share account plus a qualifying checking account, consumer loan, or credit card using your code, and keeps it open for 60 days (checking must receive a direct deposit).
60 days after the qualifying account/loan is opened, 15,000 points (worth $150) are deposited into your rewards account; redeem the points for cash in branch or online.
timing: Qualifying referrals must occur between 9/1/26 - 10/31/26; 15,000 points (worth $150) deposited into rewards accounts 60 days after the qualifying account/loan is opened.
